name: Emergency Lighting Check
description: Lighting in corridors/stairwells/vestibules must be emergency type
message: {room_name} lacks emergency lighting. Install self-contained luminaire.

name: Panel Water Clearance Check
description: Electrical panel must maintain safe distance from water sources
message: Panel {room_name} is only {value}m from water source, {threshold}m minimum required. Relocate panel or provide IP-rated enclosure.

name: Circuit Load Check
description: Final circuit load must not exceed rated capacity (ring circuit up to 32A permitted)
message: Panel {room_name} circuit load {value}A exceeds limit {threshold}A (ring circuit rating). Split circuit or use radial circuit.

name: Socket Outlet Coverage Check
description: Socket outlets provided for intended use; no hard spacing limit in SS 638
message: Outlet {room_name} spacing {value}m exceeds advisory guideline {threshold}m. Additional outlets recommended based on point-of-use assessment.

name: Exit Sign Check (equipment)
description: Luminaires shall include exit-sign functionality (awaits has_exit_sign field)

name: Emergency Lighting Minimum Illuminance
description: Minimum illuminance on escape routes shall not be below 1 lx (awaits illuminance_lx field)

name: Fire Panel Fire-Rating Check
description: Fire-fighting electrical panels shall be fire-rated (awaits fire_rated field)
message: Panel {room_name} has no fire-rating indication; fire-fighting circuits require a fire-rated panel.
